definitions.explanation: Instructions on how to properly store food, medicine, or other products. Commonly printed on food packaging labels in Japan.

examples.japanese: {保存方法|ほぞんほうほう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{保存方法|ほぞんほうほう}：{直射日光|ちょくしゃにっこう}を{避|さ}け、{涼|すず}しい{場所|ばしょ}で{保存|ほぞん}。
examples.english: Storage: Store away from direct sunlight in a cool place.

examples.japanese: {開封後|かいふうご}の{保存方法|ほぞんほうほう}は{商品|しょうひん}によって{異|こと}なるので、ラベルを{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Storage instructions after opening vary by product, so please check the label.

notes:
COMPONENTS: {保存|ほぞん} (preservation/storage) + {方法|ほうほう} (method).

A standard heading on Japanese food packaging labels, alongside other required information such as {原材料名|げんざいりょうめい} (ingredients), {賞味期限|しょうみきげん} (best-before date), and {製造者|せいぞうしゃ} (manufacturer).

COMMON STORAGE INSTRUCTIONS ON LABELS:
- {直射日光|ちょくしゃにっこう}を{避|さ}ける — avoid direct sunlight
- {冷暗所|れいあんしょ}で{保存|ほぞん} — store in a cool, dark place
- {要冷蔵|ようれいぞう} — requires refrigeration
- {開封後|かいふうご}は{早|はや}めにお{召|め}し{上|あ}がりください — consume promptly after opening
